verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, and an email product could plausibly offer automations with versioning, review, and rollback, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents automations that can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The MCP capability list covers only email actions (send, label, delete), and Drizzle Studio is a developer database tool, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
